subject: CS360
filterSummary: Successfully selected 10 videos covering all 5 topics in both English and Arabic. The English selections are from highly-regarded channels like Gate Smashers, Jeremy's IT Lab, Neso Academy, and PowerCert, ensuring high quality and relevance. The Arabic selections are also from popular, well-explained sources, with a strong emphasis on practical demonstrations and academic depth where appropriate. All hard gates and constraints were met.

coverage.note: Many candidates were in English despite Arabic titles.
